title: Seat and support concerns
summary: Feedback centers on seat support and lumbar adjustment, but many fragments are too vague or mix in unrelated customer-service and feature-support topics to determine a clear overall sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention strong customer follow-up or generally comfortable seats despite limited side bolster support.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes recurring issues and poor support in addressing them.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention lumbar support, seat adjustment, or support-related topics without enough context to classify sentiment, and some examples are unrelated to seating.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined, so the evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
The cluster mixes seat support and lumbar adjustment with unrelated topics such as customer support, Apple CarPlay support, and drivetrain explanations.
Several fragments are shorthand labels or service-writeup notes that lack enough context to interpret customer sentiment reliably.
